title: fix(transit): return None for non-UTF-8 continuation in extract_body_msgid
description: extract_body_msgid silently drops non-UTF-8 continuation lines, returning a truncated Message-ID as the dedup key. A malicious peer can use this to bypass dedup by sending a Message-ID whose continuation fragment is non-UTF-8. Fix: return None (unwrap_or_default → empty string → mandatory header check rejects it) when any continuation fragment is invalid UTF-8.
